it sells energy, not telecommunications, broadband or managed IT services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Diversified holding company whose main businesses are billboard advertising and insurance; broadband is only one segment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Cloud phone and web hosting sold mainly to small businesses through partners; no owned network or consumer wireless base."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Designs session border controllers and communications software sold to carriers; a hardware and software vendor, not a network service provider."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Rural and suburban fiber internet, voice and video sold to households and small businesses over its own network, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Wireless plus wireline broadband in rural and midsize markets, sold through owned stores to consumers, businesses and government, with managed IT."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a REIT leasing fiber and copper capacity to carriers under long-term contracts; retail broadband is a small side business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Satellite broadband and defense communications using satellite fleets; differs in technology, end markets and customers from terrestrial Alaska telecom."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes network test equipment, optical security materials and fiber components;
